metadata.title: fix #1609: optimize gateway sync bulk operations
metadata.author: KhanTabish01

description:
## 📌 Summary
Gateway sync operations cause lock escalation when processing large numbers of tools/resources/prompts due to row-by-row deletes and unbatched inserts.

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
Sync gateway with 100+ tools/resources/prompts - observe lock contention and slow performance under concurrent load.

## 🐞 Root Cause
Row-by-row deletes (N DELETE statements) and large unflushed inserts holding database locks too long, causing lock escalation from row to page/table level.

## 💡 Fix Description
- Replaced row-by-row deletes with bulk DELETE using `db.execute(delete(Model).where(Model.id.in_(ids)))`
- Added 50-item chunked inserts with `db.flush()` after each batch
- Enabled DB-level CASCADE via `ondelete="CASCADE"` on ForeignKeys
- Added `passive_deletes=True` to relationships for ORM efficiency

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Lint suite                            | `make lint`          | ✅     |
| Unit tests                            | `make test`          | ✅     |
| Coverage ≥ 90 %                       | `make coverage`      | ✅     |
| Manual regression no longer fails     | Code review          | ✅     |

## 📐 MCP Compliance
- [x] Matches current MCP spec (internal optimization only)
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist
- [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Optimizes gateway sync bulk operations to reduce database lock contention and improve performance.

## Changes

### 1. Bulk DELETE Operations

**Before:** Row-by-row deletes using `db.delete(obj)` in a loop (N DELETE statements)

**After:** Single bulk DELETE using `db.execute(delete(Model).where(Model.id.in_(ids)))`

- Reduces N DELETE statements to 1 per entity type
- Chunked to 500 items per query to avoid SQLite's 999 parameter limit

### 2. Foreign Key Safe Deletions

Child records are now explicitly deleted before parent records to prevent FK constraint violations on PostgreSQL/MariaDB:

- **Tools:** `ToolMetric`, `server_tool_association` → `Tool`
- **Resources:** `ResourceMetric`, `server_resource_association`, `ResourceSubscription` → `Resource`
- **Prompts:** `PromptMetric`, `server_prompt_association` → `Prompt`

### 3. Session State Management

Added `db.expire(gateway)` after bulk deletes to clear cached relationships and prevent SQLAlchemy from attempting to re-delete already-deleted items.

### 4. Chunked Inserts

**Before:** Single `db.add_all(items)` for all items

**After:** Items added in 50-item chunks with `db.flush()` after each chunk to:
- Prevent excessive memory usage in SQLAlchemy's identity map
- Reduce lock hold time

### 5. Database-Level CASCADE (db.py)

Added `ondelete="CASCADE"` to Tool/Resource/Prompt → Gateway foreign keys and `passive_deletes=True` to Gateway relationships as a safety net for direct Gateway deletions.

## Affected Functions

All 3 gateway sync paths updated consistently:
- `_sync_oauth_protected_gateway`
- `update_gateway`
- `_reactivate_gateway_async`

## Database Compatibility

| Database | Status |
|----------|--------|
| SQLite | ✅ Chunking avoids 999 parameter limit |
| PostgreSQL | ✅ Explicit child deletes prevent FK violations |
| MariaDB | ✅ Same as PostgreSQL |

## Performance Impact

| Operation | Before | After |
|-----------|--------|-------|
| Delete 100 tools | 100 DELETE statements | 1 DELETE statement |
| Insert 100 tools | 1 large transaction | 2 smaller transactions (50+50) |

Addresses #1609 partially

commits.message:
fix #1609: optimize gateway sync bulk operations

Replace row-by-row deletes with bulk DELETE statements across three
gateway sync paths (OAuth, update, reactivation) to prevent lock
escalation. Add 50-item chunked inserts with progressive flushing
to avoid excessive lock holding.

Enable database-level cascade deletions via ondelete='CASCADE' on
gateway foreign keys and passive_deletes=True on relationships for
improved performance.

- Bulk DELETE reduces N operations to 1 SQL statement
- Chunked inserts prevent lock escalation (50-item batches)
- DB-level CASCADE delegates deletion to database engine
- No API or behavioral changes (backward compatible)
